title: Protocol for NEBNext rRNA Depletion and RNA Library Prep for Illumina
author: New England Biolabs

materials: NEBNext Ultra II Directional RNA Library Prep Kit for Illumina

Total RNA Input Dilution Required 1,000 ng–101 ng 5–fold dilution in Adaptor Dilution Buffer 100 ng–10 ng 25–fold dilution in Adaptor Dilution Buffer 5 ng 200–fold dilution in Adaptor Dilution Buffer *The NEBNext adaptor is provided in NEBNext oligos kit. [ ! ] Incubate the sample in a preheated thermocycler with the heated lid set at ≥ 80 °C as follows: Note: If you are following recommendations in Appendix A (Chapter 6), for libraries with longer inserts (> 200 bases), increase the incubation at 42°C from 15 minutes to 50 minutes at Step 2 below. Step 1: 00:10:00 at 25 °C Step 2: 00:15:00 at 42 °C Step 3: 00:15:00 at 70 °C Step 4: Hold at 4 °C

steps.title: Prepare rRNA Depletion Mix
steps.instruction: Prepare a RNA/Probe master mix consisting of 1 µL NEBNext rRNA Depletion Solution (Cat #E6313) and 2 µL Probe Hybridization Buffer (Cat #E6314) for a total volume of 3 µL.

steps.title: Hybridize Probes to RNA
steps.instruction: Dilute total RNA with Nuclease-free Water to a final volume of 12 µL in a PCR tube and keep on ice. Add 3 µL of the rRNA Depletion mix to the 12 µL RNA (total volume 15 µL).

substeps.instruction: Mix by pipetting up and down at least 10 times.
Spin down briefly in a microcentrifuge.
Incubate in a thermocycler with a heated lid set to approximately 0 µL (sic) using the following program: 95°C for 2 min, ramp down to 22°C at 0.1°C/sec, and hold at 22°C for 5 min.
Spin down in a microcentrifuge and place on ice.

steps.title: Perform RNase H Digestion
steps.instruction: Assemble the RNase H master mix on ice: 2 μl NEBNext RNase H (Cat #E6318), 2 μl RNase H Reaction Buffer (Cat #E6312), and 1 μl Nuclease-free Water (Cat #E6317) for a total volume of 5 μl.

substeps.instruction: Mix thoroughly by pipetting up and down at least 10 times.
Add 5 µL of the RNase H master mix to the RNA sample (total volume 20 µL).
Incubate in a thermocycler for 30 minutes at 37 °C with the lid set to 40 °C (or on).
Briefly spin down in a microcentrifuge and place on ice.

steps.title: Perform DNase I Digestion
steps.instruction: Assemble the DNase I master mix on ice in a nuclease-free tube: 5 μl DNase I Reaction Buffer (Cat #E6315), 2.5 μl DNase I (RNase-free) (Cat #E6316), and 22.5 μl Nuclease-free Water (Cat #E6317) for a total volume of 30 μl.

substeps.instruction: Add 30 µL of DNase I master mix to 20 µL RNA sample (total volume 50 µL).
Mix thoroughly by pipetting up and down 10 times.
Incubate in a thermocycler for 30 minutes at 37 °C with the heated lid set to 40 °C (or on).
Briefly spin down in a microcentrifuge and place on ice.

steps.title: Purify RNA with Beads
steps.instruction: Vortex Agencourt RNAClean XP Beads or NEBNext Sample Purification Beads (Cat #E6315) to resuspend. Add 110 µL (2.2X) beads to the RNA sample and mix by pipetting up and down at least 10 times.

substeps.instruction: Incubate for 15 minutes on ice.
Place on a magnetic rack; once the solution is clear, discard the supernatant.
Add 200 µL of freshly prepared 80% ethanol to the beads in the rack, incubate at room temperature for 30 seconds, and discard the supernatant.
Repeat the ethanol wash once more (total of 2 washes).
Air dry beads on the magnetic rack for up to 5 minutes (do not over-dry; beads should remain dark brown and glossy).
Remove from magnet and elute RNA by adding 7 µL Nuclease-free Water (Cat #E6317). Mix by pipetting up and down 10 times and spin briefly.
Incubate for 2 minutes at room temperature, then place on the magnet until the solution is clear (~2 minutes).
Transfer 5 µL of the supernatant to a nuclease-free tube and place on ice.

steps.title: Fragment and Prime RNA
steps.instruction: For intact or partially degraded RNA, assemble the following reaction on ice: 5 µl Ribosomal RNA Depleted Sample, 4 µl NEBNext First Strand Synthesis Reaction Buffer (Cat #E7421), and 1 µl Random Primers (Cat #E7422) for a total volume of 10 µl.

substeps.instruction: Mix thoroughly by pipetting up and down 10 times.
Incubate in a thermocycler at 94 °C based on RIN value: Intact RNA (>7) for 15 min; Partially Degraded DNA (2–6) for 7–8 min.
Immediately transfer the tube to ice.

steps.title: First Strand cDNA Synthesis
steps.instruction: Assemble the first strand synthesis reaction on ice by adding the following to the fragmented/primed RNA: 10 µl Fragmented and Primed RNA, 8 µl NEBNext Strand Specificity Reagent (Cat #E7766), and 2 µl NEBNext First Strand Synthesis Enzyme Mix (Cat #E7761) for a total volume of 20 µl.

substeps.instruction: Mix thoroughly by pipetting up and down 10 times.

steps.title: Second Strand cDNA Synthesis
steps.instruction: Assemble the second strand synthesis reaction on ice: 20 µl First Strand Synthesis Product, 8 µl NEBNext Second Strand Synthesis Reaction Buffer with dUTP (10X) (Cat #E7426), 4 µl NEBNext Second Strand Synthesis Enzyme Mix (Cat #E7425), and 48 µl Nuclease-free Water (Cat #E7764) for a total volume of 80 µl.

substeps.instruction: Mix thoroughly by pipetting up and down at least 10 times while keeping on ice.
Incubate in a thermocycler for 1 hour at 16 °C with the heated lid set at ≤ 40 °C (or off).

steps.title: Purify Second Strand cDNA
steps.instruction: Vortex NEBNext Sample Purification Beads (Cat #E6315) to resuspend. Add 144 µL (1.8X) beads to the ~80 µL second strand synthesis reaction and mix well.

substeps.instruction: Incubate for 5 minutes at room temperature.
Spin briefly, place on a magnet, and discard the supernatant.
Wash beads twice with 200 µL freshly prepared 80% ethanol (30 seconds per wash).
Air dry beads for up to 5 minutes (do not over-dry).
Remove from magnet and elute DNA by adding 53 µL 0.1X TE Buffer (Cat #E7763). Mix well, spin quickly, and incubate for 2 minutes at room temperature.
Place on magnet until clear and transfer 50 µL of the supernatant to a clean nuclease-free PCR tube.

steps.title: End Prep Reaction
steps.instruction: Assemble the end prep reaction on ice: 50 µl Second Strand Synthesis Product, 7 µl NEBNext Ultra II End Prep Reaction Buffer (Cat #E7647), and 3 µl NEBNext Ultra II End Prep Enzyme Mix (Cat #E7646) for a total volume of 60 µl. (Alternatively, add 10 µL of a prepared master mix to 50 µL cDNA).

substeps.instruction: Mix by pipetting the entire volume up and down at least 10 times using a 100 or 200 μl pipette set to 50 μl, then spin quickly.
Incubate in a thermocycler with heated lid ≥ 75 °C: 30 min at 20 °C, 30 min at 65 °C, then hold at 4 °C.

steps.title: Adaptor Ligation
steps.instruction: Assemble the ligation reaction on ice in the following order: 60 µl End Prepped DNA, 2.5 µl Diluted Adaptor, 1 µl NEBNext Ligation Enhancer (Cat #E7374), and 30 µl NEBNext Ultra II Ligation Master Mix (Cat #E7648) for a total volume of 93.5 µl.

substeps.instruction: Mix by pipetting the entire volume up and down at least 10 times using a 100 or 200 μl pipette set to 80 μl, then spin quickly.
Incubate for 15 minutes at 20 °C in a thermocycler.

steps.title: USER Enzyme Treatment
steps.instruction: Add 3 µL NEBNext USER Enzyme (Cat #E7458) to the ligation mixture (total volume 96.5 µL).

substeps.instruction: Mix well and incubate at 37 °C for 15 minutes with the heated lid set to ≥ 45 °C.

steps.title: Size Selection and Purification
steps.instruction: Add 87 µL (0.9X) resuspended NEBNext Sample Purification Beads (Cat #E7767) to the mixture and mix well.

substeps.instruction: Incubate for 10 minutes at room temperature.
Spin briefly, place on a magnetic rack, and discard the supernatant after ~5 minutes.
Wash beads twice with 200 µL freshly prepared 80% ethanol (30 seconds per wash).
Spin briefly and place back on the magnetic rack.
Air dry beads for up to 5 minutes (do not over-dry).
Remove from rack and elute DNA by adding 17 µL 0.1X TE. Mix well, spin quickly, and incubate for 2 minutes at room temperature.
Place on magnet until clear and transfer 15 µL of the supernatant to a clean PCR tube.

steps.title: PCR Enrichment
steps.instruction: Set up the PCR reaction based on the oligo type (all oligos should be 10 μM). Option A (Separate Primers): 14 µl Ligated DNA, 25 µl NEBNext Ultra II Q5 Master Mix, 5 µl Universal/i5 Primer, 5 µl Index(X)/i7 Primer (50 µl total). Option B (Combined Primers): 15 µl Ligated DNA, 25 µl NEBNext Ultra II Q5 Master Mix, 10 µl Index(X)/Universal Primer Mix (50 µl total).

substeps.instruction: Mix by gently pipetting up and down 10 times and spin quickly.
Incubate in a thermocycler with heated lid at 105°C using: 98°C for 30s (1 cycle); 98°C for 10s, 65°C for 75s (7–16 cycles based on RNA input); 65°C for 5 min (1 cycle); hold at 4°C.

steps.title: Final Library Purification
steps.instruction: Vortex NEBNext Sample Purification Beads (Cat #E6315) to resuspend. Add 45 µL (0.9X) beads to the ~50 µL PCR reaction and mix well.

substeps.instruction: Incubate for 5 minutes at room temperature.
Spin briefly, place on a magnetic rack, and discard the supernatant.
Wash beads twice with 200 µL freshly prepared 80% ethanol (30 seconds per wash).
Air dry beads for up to 5 minutes (do not over-dry).
Remove from rack and elute DNA by adding 23 µL 0.1X TE. Mix by pipetting 10 times, spin quickly, and incubate for 2 minutes at room temperature.
Place on magnet until clear and transfer 20 µL of the supernatant to a clean PCR tube and store at –20°C.

steps.title: Library Quality Control
steps.instruction: Run 1 µL of the library on a DNA 1000 chip (or High Sensitivity chip if yield is low).

substeps.instruction: Verify the electropherogram shows a narrow distribution with a peak size of approximately 300 bp.
If peaks at ~80 bp or 128 bp are visible, increase sample volume to 50 μl with 0.1X TE and repeat the final bead purification.
